From 789d54a4178634850e441f60c0326124138e7269 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Quinn Tran <qutran@marvell.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Jun 2022 21:46:25 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] scsi: qla2xxx: edif: Fix n2n discovery issue with secure
 target

User failed to see disk via n2n topology. Driver used up all login retries
before authentication application started. When authentication application
started, driver did not have enough login retries to connect securely. On
app_start, driver will reset the login retry attempt count.

Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20220607044627.19563-10-njavali@marvell.com
Fixes: 4de067e5df12 ("scsi: qla2xxx: edif: Add N2N support for EDIF")
Signed-off-by: Quinn Tran <qutran@marvell.com>
Signed-off-by: Nilesh Javali <njavali@marvell.com>
Signed-off-by: Martin K. Petersen <martin.petersen@oracle.com>

diff --git a/drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_edif.c b/drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_edif.c
index 3ece46ae9d6b..d31dd942bfb0 100644
--- a/drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_edif.c
+++ b/drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_edif.c
@@ -515,6 +515,9 @@ qla_edif_app_start(scsi_qla_host_t *vha, struct bsg_job *bsg_job)
 	}
 
 	if (N2N_TOPO(vha->hw)) {
+		list_for_each_entry_safe(fcport, tf, &vha->vp_fcports, list)
+			fcport->n2n_link_reset_cnt = 0;
+
 		if (vha->hw->flags.n2n_fw_acc_sec)
 			set_bit(N2N_LINK_RESET, &vha->dpc_flags);
 		else
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_edif.c`**
   - Added a loop that resets the `n2n_link_reset_cnt` for each `fcport` in the `vp_fcports` list to zero. This is done to ensure that the login retry attempt count is reset when the authentication application starts.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in `qla_edif.c` addresses a bug related to the n2n discovery issue with secure targets. By resetting the `n2n_link_reset_cnt` for each `fcport`, the driver ensures that it has sufficient login retries available when the authentication application begins. This change is crucial for allowing the driver to successfully connect to the secure target, thereby fixing the issue where the user could not see the disk in an n2n topology due to exhausted login retries.

```c

```

```

```
Reason:
The driver was exhausting all login retries before the authentication application started, which meant that by the time the application was ready, there were insufficient retries left for secure connections. The `login_retry` count was set to the maximum allowed, but it was not being reset when the authentication application began, leading to the inability to connect securely.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
list_for_each_entry_safe(fcport, tf, &vha->vp_fcports, list)
    fcport->n2n_link_reset_cnt = 0;
```
Reason:
This code resets the `n2n_link_reset_cnt` for each `fcport` when the authentication application starts. By resetting this count, the driver ensures that it has enough login retries available for establishing secure connections, thus preventing the issue of exhausting retries before the application is ready.
